risks.note: Fertilizer profitability depends on government nutrient pricing, subsidy mechanisms, import rules and distribution systems, and on subsidies arriving on time.
Fertilizer sales depend on monsoon patterns, agricultural output, cropping patterns and overall rural demand.
Key fertilizer inputs, footwear materials (leather, synthetics, rubber) and FMCG inputs move with global commodity prices and foreign exchange.
Domestic and international brands, fast-changing fashion trends, pricing pressure and e-commerce penetration require continuous product innovation.

Drone and geospatial work is exposed to frequent rule changes on drone operations, licensing, airspace and data privacy, as well as technological obsolescence, cybersecurity threats and dependence on skilled professionals.
Railway, ICF and PSU contracts involve competitive bidding, strict eligibility, contract renewal risk, extended payment cycles, significant working capital and penalties for missing service levels.
Food safety and quality requirements, statutory compliance, rising input costs and shifting consumer preferences may affect performance.
risks.risk: Food safety and compliance in FMCG and food services
